summary.es: Michi vigila el borde donde el plano termina y empieza el neón. Esta noche alguien intenta cruzar.
summary.en: Michi watches the edge where the drawing ends and the neon begins. Tonight someone tries to cross.

panels.es: Toda ciudad empieza como un plano. Líneas blancas, cotas, tolerancias. Lo que se puede construir.
panels.en: Every city begins as a drawing. White lines, dimensions, tolerances. What can be built.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: an architectural blueprint of a city drawn in thin white lines on deep obsidian, the lines starting to glow sapphire at the top edge, cinematic, ArchiKatz style.

panels.es: Pero arriba del último piso, donde el plano termina, empieza otra ciudad. La que nadie dibujó.
panels.en: But above the top floor, where the drawing ends, another city begins. The one nobody drew.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: a brutalist concrete tower whose upper floors dissolve into neon geometry and amethyst light, cyber-brutalist city at night, rain, cinematic.

panels.es: Ahí vive Michi. Gata atigrada, ojos verdes, collar táctico. La Guardiana del Umbral.
panels.en: Michi lives there. Tabby cat, green eyes, tactical collar. The Guardian of the Threshold.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: close-up of a fierce tabby cat with piercing green eyes and a tactical collar, perched on a brutalist concrete ledge, holographic screens behind her, ultra-detailed fur, ArchiKatz.
Vertical webtoon panel: holographic monitoring screens floating in the dark, one screen flashing an alert with a red outline of a building section, data streams, sapphire light.

panels.speaker: Michi
panels.es: Alguien está dibujando un piso que no debería existir.
panels.en: Someone is drawing a floor that shouldn't exist.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: Michi the tabby cat narrows her green eyes, reflection of a red alert in her pupils, tense atmosphere, cinematic lighting.

panels.es: En la terraza, una silueta en techwear oscuro y casco negro traza líneas de luz en el aire. El arquitecto.
panels.en: On the rooftop, a silhouette in dark techwear and a black helmet traces lines of light in the air. The architect.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: a silhouetted figure in dark techwear and a black helmet on a rooftop, drawing glowing gold blueprint lines in the air with his hand, city of neon below, rain, cinematic, ArchiKatz.

panels.speaker: Brian
panels.es: Tranquila, Michi. Solo estoy probando qué pasa si la ciudad sigue creciendo hacia arriba.
panels.en: Easy, Michi. I'm just testing what happens if the city keeps growing upward.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: the architect turns his head slightly toward the cat, calm, gold light on the helmet visor, rain drops, intimate framing.

panels.speaker: Michi
panels.es: Lo que no se construye también tiene peso. Y alguien tiene que sostenerlo.
panels.en: What isn't built has weight too. And someone has to hold it up.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: Michi sitting upright, serious, her tactical collar glowing cyan, the neon city reflected behind her, cinematic.

panels.es: Esa noche el plano creció un piso. Y el umbral, un poco más.
panels.en: That night the drawing grew one floor. And the threshold, a little more.
panels.prompt: Vertical webtoon panel: wide shot of the tower with a new glowing gold floor added on top, the line between concrete and neon shifted upward, Michi tiny on the ledge, end of episode mood.

panels.es: Continuará en el episodio 1 · Habitando lo no construido
panels.en: To be continued in episode 1 · Inhabiting the unbuilt
